$comment: Repository ruleset for main (5 Nov 2026). Apply once from a laptop with an admin token: gh api -X POST repos/pioche8/ESCP-2627DT-C1/rulesets --input .github/ruleset-main.json . It requires a pull request (0 approvals) and the two CI jobs "check" and "smoke" (strict: the branch must be up to date with main), and blocks force pushes and deletion. The Repository admin role bypasses it in "always" mode, so the rollback `git push --force-with-lease origin release/v1-workshop:main` still works for an admin. Remove it under Settings → Rules → Rulesets → this ruleset → Delete, or: gh api -X DELETE repos/pioche8/ESCP-2627DT-C1/rulesets/<id> (ids: gh api repos/pioche8/ESCP-2627DT-C1/rulesets). The build container's proxy refuses write access to this API path, so the session of 5 Nov could not apply it (CLAUDE.md §11 item 92).
name: main: pull request + check + smoke, no force push
